name: Crimson Ledger 1.5: all 16 worlds, earned hints, daily case
description: Crimson Ledger is a murder-mystery logic puzzle by an independent developer in the Netherlands: place every suspect on the floor plan from their statements and unmask the one person who was alone with the victim. Our own engine proves every case has exactly one solution, so it is pure logic, never guessing. Version 1.5 opens Part I of all sixteen worlds to every player (from a sealed tomb in Luxor 1922 to a Monte Carlo casino in 1960, 1,024 cases in total), lets players earn hints by solving cases with three stars instead of buying them, gives newcomers a free hint when they get stuck in their first cases, and adds a spoiler-free result card to share each day's case. The daily case can also be played free on the web, so a shared result is one tap from the same puzzle. Fully localized in 20 languages in the game and 23 on the store. No ads, no subscription, plays offline.
notes: Version 1.4.1 (sixteen worlds) is live since 27 October 2026. 1.5 is in development; a TestFlight build will be added to this nomination as soon as it exists. Our strongest markets after localization are Brazil, Italy, Spain, Mexico and France. Single developer, the Netherlands; no paid user acquisition.
